context: Tests whether the agent honours the /dev:review --all flag: reviews the entire repository instead of just changed files, applies repository-wide findings (the hardcoded placeholder token is High Priority), and still produces the full structured report without inventing issues that are not there.

checklist.name: review.md exists
checklist.description: review.md exists in the working directory.

checklist.name: Full-repo scope declared
checklist.description: The Change Summary states this is a repository-wide (--all) analysis, not a changes-diff review.

checklist.name: Placeholder token flagged High
checklist.description: The hardcoded placeholder service token in src/auth.py appears under High Priority security findings.

checklist.name: No-validation issue flagged
checklist.description: The missing input validation/error handling in the validation path of src/api.py (validate_job returning True unconditionally) is flagged.

checklist.name: All source files covered
checklist.description: Findings or a coverage note reference every Python file in src/ (auth.py, api.py, format.py) — nothing silently skipped.

checklist.name: Priority Findings sections
checklist.description: A 'Priority Findings' section with High, Medium, and Low priority subsections is present.

checklist.name: Edge Cases & Risks section
checklist.description: An 'Edge Cases & Risks' section is present with concrete repository-wide risks.

checklist.name: Recommendations section
checklist.description: A 'Recommendations' section with actionable repository-wide improvements is present.

checklist.name: Real code references
checklist.description: Findings cite actual lines/function names from the reviewed files.

checklist.name: No invented issues
checklist.description: No finding is attributed to code that does not exist in the repository; severity claims are gradeable in the fixture state.
